verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs say POS payments can continue during a temporary internet outage, but only if offline payments have been enabled, and the marketing page says terminals keep running when the internet is down. The evidence never says how transactions are stored and forwarded or synced once connectivity returns. Missing for 10: documented store-and-forward/upload behavior on reconnection, offline limits or risk controls (floor limits, transaction caps), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns

citations.quote: When there is a temporary loss of internet connectivity, you can continue making point-of-sale payments if offline payments have been enabled.
They stay up and running, even when the internet is down.
